title: thaan
summary: "Heritage threads, modern vision" — a fashion brand's packaging built around archival photography.
description: thaan pairs handwoven Indian textiles with a contemporary silhouette, and the packaging needed to hold both halves of that story. Archival riverfront photography anchors the box interior while a restrained monochrome exterior and bilingual wordmark carry the brand across stationery, hang tags and lookbook pages.

cover.alt: thaan fashion brand packaging with heritage photography and business cards
